Essentially, the Know Sure Thing Indicator measures the momentum of four separate price cycles.

The “Auto” setting selects the following pivot timeframes: 1D for chart resolutions up to and including 15 min 1W for chart resolutions greater than 15 min and less than 1 day 1M for chart resolutions from 1 day and above

デイトレ.逐語: Timeframes for Pivot Points Pivot Points for 1-, 5-, 10-, and 15-minute charts use the prior day's high, low, and close.
Pivot Points for 30-, 60-, and 120-minute charts use the prior week's high, low, and close.

デイトレ.単位: 週（15分より長く1日より短い足）
デイトレ.逐語: The “Auto” setting selects the following pivot timeframes: 1D for chart resolutions up to and including 15 min 1W for chart resolutions greater than 15 min and less than 1 day 1M for chart resolutions from 1 day and above

役割.逐語: Pivot Points Standard The Pivot Points Standard technical indicator displays levels at which price might meet support or resistance.
Pivot Points use the prior period's high, low, and close to estimate future support and resistance levels.

元の指標: Volume Profile（POC・Value Area の VAH／VAL）

既定.逐語: Typically, this percentage is set to 70%, however, it is up to the trader’s discretion.
Multiply the total volume by the chosen percentage (default 70%) to determine the target volume for the value area.
Value Area Percentage : Set the percentage of volume to be included in the Value Area (default is 70%).

パラメータ.名前: プロファイルの期間（Session／Fixed Range／Visible Range など）

デイトレ.逐語: The SVP is commonly used by day traders since a new profile is generated each day.

範囲.逐語: Set Rows Layout to Number of Rows and use a row count between 100 and 200 (200 for intraday charts, 100 for daily and higher) so each bar represents a tight enough price band to be meaningful.

スキャル.逐語: Set Rows Layout to Number of Rows and use a row count between 100 and 200 (200 for intraday charts, 100 for daily and higher) so each bar represents a tight enough price band to be meaningful.

デイトレ.逐語: Set Rows Layout to Number of Rows and use a row count between 100 and 200 (200 for intraday charts, 100 for daily and higher) so each bar represents a tight enough price band to be meaningful.

役割.逐語: Typical levels of significance Point of control (POC): The price level for the time period with the highest traded volume.
The upper edge is the Value Area High (VAH) and the lower edge is the Value Area Low (VAL).
